program_overview.title: Full Stack Web Development Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: The complete road from a first HTML tag to a deployed, tested, AI-capable application, walked at a professional pace in twelve months.
program_overview.description:
Full stack development remains the most employable generalist skill in software: one person who can take an idea from empty folder to running product. This live online masterclass builds that person deliberately, from absolute zero, using the stack that dominates hiring in 2026: JavaScript and TypeScript, React and Next.js, Node and Express, MongoDB and PostgreSQL, with Docker, CI/CD and cloud fundamentals where employers expect them.

The arc runs in four phases. Foundations first: HTML, CSS and JavaScript learned to real depth, including the asynchronous patterns most self-taught developers never quite trust. Then the modern frontend: TypeScript, React with hooks and honest state management, styling with Tailwind, and a production-grade frontend capstone. Then the backend: Express APIs designed properly, both database families (document and relational), authentication done safely, OWASP security and real-time features. The final phase is what separates course graduates from employable developers: testing, Next.js, performance, Docker, CI pipelines, cloud fundamentals, a system design introduction, AI features built with guardrails, and a capstone shipped like a product.

The pace is honest: two live classes a week plus four to six hours of practice fits this in twelve months, and learners who need longer take up to fourteen, the batch adapts. Assessment is honest too: homework after every class, monthly assignments that mix new questions with earlier topics, cumulative phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate. Real knowledge, real work, real projects, depth over dopamine.
what_makes_this_different: One coherent stack learned to depth: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node, both SQL and MongoDB, the combination hiring actually asks for
Professional habits are the syllabus, not a bonus: Git workflow, testing, code review, CI, Docker and deployment run through the course
Everything ships: projects live on public URLs from month 3, ending in a deployed, tested capstone
AI features built properly: server-side model calls, streaming, retrieval over your own data, guardrails and cost control
An honest 12-month arc with 2 months of margin built in: learners who need more practice take up to 14, nobody is rushed
Real assessment: weekly homework, mixed-review assignments every month, and a final exam that decides the certificate, with focused revision and a free retest for those who fall short

faqs.question: What is full stack web development and why learn it?
faqs.answer: Full stack development means building complete web applications: the frontend users see and the backend that powers it, databases included. It remains the most employable generalist skill in software because one full stack developer can take an idea from empty folder to running product. This course teaches the specific stack hiring asks for in 2026: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node, SQL and MongoDB, plus the Docker, CI and deployment habits that separate juniors who get hired from juniors who wait.

faqs.question: How long does it take to become a full stack developer?
faqs.answer: Honestly: 12 months of consistent work at 2 live classes a week plus 4 to 6 hours of practice, and this course is paced exactly for that. The syllabus keeps 2 months of margin in hand, so learners who need more repetition take up to 14 months with no rushing and no penalty. Courses promising full stack in 8 weeks are compressing a profession into a demo; the first deployed project here ships in month 3, and the depth keeps compounding after it.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Classwork runs inside every session, homework follows every class, and each month ends with an assignment that deliberately mixes new questions with earlier topics so knowledge compounds instead of fading. Every phase closes with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions drawn from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns a focused revision plan and a free retest. We optimize for real knowledge and real depth, not attendance.

faqs.question: Do I need prior coding experience or a computer science degree?
faqs.answer: Neither. The course starts from absolute zero, how computers and the web work, and no degree is required for full stack roles; portfolios and demonstrated skill carry the interviews. What is required is consistency: this is a 12-month professional skill, and the course is structured, assessed and reviewed to keep you consistent.

faqs.question: Which technologies does the course cover?
faqs.answer: The modern hiring stack, learned in order: HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript to depth, then TypeScript, React, Redux Toolkit and Next.js on the frontend; Node.js, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Prisma on the backend; JWT auth and OWASP security; Socket.io real-time; Jest and supertest for testing; Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD and cloud deployment; a system design introduction; and AI features built server-side with guardrails.

faqs.question: What will I actually build?
faqs.answer: More than 30 real projects, each phase ending with something deployed: an API-powered site in month 3, a React and TypeScript frontend capstone in month 6, an authenticated real-time backend in month 9, and a final capstone with tests, CI, Docker and an AI feature, live on its own URL. The portfolio is the point: every claim on your CV gets a working link behind it.

faqs.question: How is AI covered in this course?
faqs.answer: As an engineering skill. Students add AI features to their own applications the way production teams do: model calls made server-side, responses streamed into React, retrieval over the app’s own data, structured output validation, guardrails against prompt injection, and cost control. The result is a developer who can ship an AI feature responsibly, which in 2026 is a hiring differentiator, not a novelty.

faqs.question: What job market context should I expect?
faqs.answer: Full stack developers remain among the most consistently hired software roles. The salary ranges shown on this page are general market bands from public industry data, shown for context only, never a promise: actual outcomes depend on your skill, portfolio, location and the market. What this course controls is the input: real projects, real depth and interview-ready fundamentals.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Is there a free demo class?
faqs.answer: Yes, book a free, no-commitment demo at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161. It is a real class, not a sales pitch: you will build something small in it and meet the teaching style directly.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Every class is live: a 1-hour online session where a real instructor works with a small group, never a pre-recorded video. You code during class, ask questions in the moment, and get unstuck immediately, which matters most in the early months.

why_this_course.title: Why Full Stack Development Is Still the Smartest Skill to Build
paragraphs: Full stack developers are the generalists every product team needs: capable of taking a feature from database schema to deployed interface without waiting on anyone. That end-to-end capability is why the role stays consistently hired through hype cycles, and why it makes such a strong first profession or career switch.

This course is deliberately honest about scope. In twelve months you will not become a senior engineer, nobody does, but you will build the complete, modern, tested foundation seniors are grown from: one coherent stack learned deeply, professional habits practiced weekly, and a portfolio where every skill has a live URL behind it.

The emphasis on real projects is the whole method: more than 30 builds, four deployed capstones, tests and CI on the work that matters, and a final exam that makes the certificate mean something. You graduate with proof, not just exposure.
highlights: A 12-month curriculum covering frontend, backend, databases, testing, Docker, CI/CD and AI features
Four deployed capstones: one per phase, each bigger than the last
Both database families: MongoDB and PostgreSQL, with Prisma for the typed modern workflow
System design introduction and interview-ready vocabulary in the final phase
